headline: HuyenBao v11.49 — Portfolio Dashboard + Sleep Debt system
summary: PORTFOLIO + SLEEP REWORK. New Portfolio tab (Finance group) shows Net worth, P&L (realized + unrealized), per-holding ROI, asset allocation donut, and a transaction ledger (last 200). Every cash-touching event (stocks, items, biz, gigs, bank, tuition, donations, travel) now records a transaction with cost-basis tracking for accurate realized P&L. Sleep system reworked: default drops from 8h to 6h per the user spec; sleep ≥ 7h now ACTIVELY RECOVERS health (was just slower decay); new 12h option for catch-up sleep; sleep debt accumulates when below 7h and is paid down at 2× rate above 7h; debt > 7 = -10% study, > 21 = -25% study + +20% decay + recovery blocked.
features: NEW: Portfolio tab in Finance group — Net worth, Total invested, Realized P&L, Unrealized P&L, Overall ROI, 30-day cash flow
NEW: Asset allocation donut chart (cash / savings / stocks / assets / biz)
NEW: Holdings table with per-asset ROI (stocks + lots combined, sorted by value)
NEW: Transaction ledger (last 200 txns, with kind/name/amount/realized P&L)

NEW: Transaction recording in trade(), buyItem(), sellLot(), bankOp(), doGig(), donate(), enrollLic(), foundClub(), joinClub(), travel(), openBranch(), openBranchCapital(), acceptBizOffer(), franchiseBranch(), buyFarmLine(), buyFacLine(), buySpace()
NEW: Weighted-average cost basis tracking per stock id (s.costBasis) — sells deduct proportional basis + record realized P&L
NEW: Sleep debt system (s.sleepDebt 0..35) — accumulates 1h per deficit-hour/day, pays down at 2h per surplus-hour/day
NEW: sleepHealthRecovery() — 7h+ sleep now actively heals (+0.05/day at 7h up to +0.50/day at 12h catch-up)
NEW: 12h option in sleep schedule (marked ✓ for catch-up)
NEW: Sleep-debt penalty: >7 debt = -10% study, >21 debt = -25% study + +20% decay + recovery blocked
NEW: PinZone shows sleep debt indicator (3 tiers: Rested / Tired / Exhausted) + recovery note
NEW: Health-change display now shows '+X%/day recovery' when sleeping ≥ 7h
CHANGE: default sleepHours drops from 8 → 6 (per user spec: +12% study / +15% decay trade-off)
CHANGE: sleepHealthMult kept positive (recovery handled separately to preserve the existing display formula)
24 new tests (160 → 184 total) covering sleep debt + portfolio calculations
